newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 climbs to fresh record after holiday.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 climbs to fresh record after holiday.

text.p: The London stock market on Friday extended its record-breaking run, returning from the Christmas holiday to hit a new peak with the aid of higher futures and bonds and a further advance on Wall Street, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 index of blue-chip share prices hit a high of 4,101.2, up 8.7 points, compared with its previous record intraday high of 4,100 set last Friday.
March FTSE 100 futures rose 20.0 points to 4,103.
Volume was light and was expected to thin out further with London markets set to close at 1230 GMT.
